stem: Which results did Ford hope to achieve by implementing the process described in this excerpt?

options.label: J
options.text: Reduced payroll taxes and employee benefits

visual_elements: One man fits the parts together, so that the bolt holes come right. The next man fits the bolt holes into place. The next has a pan of nuts before him and all day he scoops them up and with his fingers starts them on the thread of the bolts. The next man has a wrench and he gives the final twist that makes them tight. —John A. Fitch, 1914
